name: Lower Merion Special Recreation Afternoon Camp
street_address: Belmont Hills Pool, 122 Mary Watersford Rd
description_short: Afternoon camp for children and teens with special needs, ages 7 to 18, who spend the afternoon swimming with township staff at the Belmont Hills public pool. Runs Monday to Thursday, 1:30 to 4:30, for about six weeks with a group limit of six.
special_needs_notes: Program is for children with special needs; group limit of 6. Families in Lower Merion ESY may have after school transport from the school district.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming at the Belmont Hills public pool with township staff, weather permitting.
refund_policy_summary: No refund or makeup for weather cancellations; an extreme case such as a whole week lost is handled case by case with a credit toward a future program.

sessions.name: Summer program, Monday to Thursday 1:30 to 4:30

notes: 2026 fee: non-residents $1,020, Lower Merion residents $850. Parent pick up only; no transportation home at the end of camp. 2027 not yet posted.
